SELECT m.manufacturer, m.name, COUNT(t.trip_id) as trip_count
FROM model m
LEFT JOIN bike b ON m.model_id = b.model_id
LEFT JOIN trip t ON b.bike_id = t.bike_id
GROUP BY m.model_id, m.manufacturer, m.name
HAVING COUNT(t.trip_id) >= (
    SELECT COUNT(t2.trip_id)
    FROM model m2
    LEFT JOIN bike b2 ON m2.model_id = b2.model_id
    LEFT JOIN trip t2 ON b2.bike_id = t2.bike_id
    WHERE m2.manufacturer = m.manufacturer
    GROUP BY m2.model_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(t2.trip_id) DESC, m2.name ASC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
)
ORDER BY m.manufacturer ASC, trip_count DESC, m.name ASC;
